chapterInfo.content:
46
Ɔberempɔn no afɔrebɔdeɛ
1Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Abannwa ponkɛseɛ a ɛhwɛ apueeɛ no, wɔnto mu adwumayɛ nna nsia no nyinaa, na homeda no deɛ, wɔnhini, na bosome foforɔ da no nso, wɔnhini. 2#Hes 44.3 Na ɔberempɔn no mfiri akyire, mfa ntwonoo kwan pono so mmɛgyina ɛpono kɛseɛ no aponnwa ho; na asɔfoɔ no mmɔ ne hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne n’asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ, na ɔnkoto nsɔre, ɛpono kɛseɛ no aponnwa ho, na ɔmfiri adi, na ɛpono kɛseɛ no deɛ, wɔnnto mu kɔsi anwummerɛ. 3Na asase no so nnipa no nso nkoto nsɔre ɛpono kɛseɛ no ano, home nna ne abosome foforɔ mu, AWURADE anim. 4#Num 28.9 Na ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a ɔberempɔn no mfa mmrɛ AWURADE no nie: Homeda, nnwanten nsia a wɔnni dɛm ne odwennini a ne ho nni dɛm; 5ne aduane afɔdeɛ: Odwennini no deɛ, efa ne nnwanten no ho aduane afɔdeɛ a ne nsa bɛso soɔ ne ngo susutoa a ɛka efa no ho. 6Na bosome foforɔ da no: Nantwiburuwa a ɔnni dɛm ne nnwanten nsia ne odwennini baako a wɔnni dɛm, 7#Hes 45.24 ne nantwinini no ho efa ne odwennini no ho efa na ɔmfa nyɛ aduane afɔdeɛ ne nnwanten no deɛ, sɛdeɛ ne nsa bɛso soɔ, ne ngo susutoa a ɛka efa ho. 8Na sɛ ɔberempɔn no rebɛhyɛne mu a, ɔmfa ɛpono kɛseɛ no ntwonoo kwan so nkɔ mu, na ɔmfa hɔ ara mfiri adi.
9Na sɛ asase no so nnipa no reba AWURADE anim, afahyɛ no mu a, deɛ ɔfa atifi fam ponkɛseɛ no kwan so ba mu bɛsɔreɛ no, ɔmfa anafoɔ fam ponkɛseɛ no kwan so mfiri adi, na deɛ ɔfa anafoɔ fam ponkɛseɛ ano ba mu no, ɔmfa atifi fam ponkɛseɛ no ano mfiri adi; ɔnnsan mmfa ɛpono kɛseɛ a ɔfaa mu baa mu no mu mmfiri adi, na ɔnkɔ n’anim tee mfiri adi. 10Na ɔberempɔn no, sɛ wɔreba mu a, ɔmfra wɔn mu mmra mu, na sɛ wɔrefiri adi a, ɔne wɔn mfiri adi.
11 # Hes 46.7 Na nnapɔnna ne afahyɛ no mu aduane afɔdeɛ nyɛ nantwinini ne aduane efa, ne odwennini ne aduane efa, ne nnwanten ho deɛ ne nsa bɛso soɔ, ne aduane efa ho ngo susutoa. 12Na sɛ ɔberempɔn no rebɛbɔ ayamyi hyeɛ afɔdeɛ anaa ayamyɛ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ ama AWURADE a, ɛnneɛ wɔnhini no ɛpono kɛseɛ a ɛhwɛ apueeɛ no, na ɔmmɔ ne hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne n’asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ, sɛdeɛ ɔyɛ no homeda no, na ɔmfiri adi; na n’adifire akyiri no, wɔnto ɛpono kɛseɛ no mu.
13 # Num 28.3 Na odwanten a wadi afe a ɔnni dɛm na fa bɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ma AWURADE; anɔpa anɔpa na bɔ; 14na siesie ɛho aduane afɔdeɛ daa anɔpa, efa nkyɛmu nsia mu baako, ne ngo susutoa nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako, na wɔmfa mfɔre esiam no na ɛnyɛ aduane afɔdeɛ mma AWURADE; ɛnyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ daa; 15na monsiesie odwanten no, ne aduane afɔdeɛ ne ngo no daa anɔpa: Ɛyɛ daa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ.
16Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Sɛ ɔberempɔn no de n’agyapadeɛ no bi kyɛ ne mma no bi a, ɛyɛ ne mma no deɛ, wɔn agyapadeɛ mu kyɛfa ne no. 17#Lew 25.10 Na sɛ ɔde n’agyapadeɛ no bi kyɛ ne nkoa mu bi a, ɛnneɛ ɛnyɛ akoa no deɛ nkɔsi ahofadie afe no so, na ɛnsane nkɔyɛ ɔberempɔn no deɛ bio, ɛyɛ ɔno ara agyapadeɛ, ne mma na ɛnyɛ wɔn deɛ. 18#Hes 45.8-9 Nanso ɔberempɔn no mmfa ɔmanfoɔ no agyapadeɛ bi, mmpam wɔn mfiri wɔn kyɛfa mu; ɔno ara ne kyɛfa no bi na ɔmfa mma ne mma na wɔnnie, deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na wɔampansam me man mu onipa biara amfiri n’agyapadeɛ soɔ. 19Ɛnna ɔde me faa ɔkwan a ɛda ɛpono kɛseɛ no nhyɛnmu no so kɔɔ adammoa kronkron a ɛyɛ asɔfoɔ dea, a ɛhwɛ atifi fam no ano, na hwɛ, afa bi wɔ hɔ, atɔeɛ fam, akyire nohoa. 20Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Ɛha ne faako a asɔfoɔ no bɛnoa asodie ho afɔdeɛ ne bɔne ho afɔdeɛ no, na wɔatoto aduane afɔdeɛ no, na wɔamfa amfiri adi ankɔ abannwa a ɛwɔ ho no so ankɔte ɔman no ho.
21Ɛnna ɔde me firii adi baa abannwa a ɛwɔ ho no soɔ, na ɔmaa mesene kɔɔ abannwa no ntweaso nnan no ho, na hwɛ, atuntuma bi wɔ abannwa no biara ntweaso. 22Abannwa no ntwea nnan no mu na ntuntuma a wɔabram ho wowɔ a ne ntwemu yɛ basafa aduonu na ne trɛ yɛ basafa dunum, ntweaso ntutuma nnan no nyinaa nsusuiɛ yɛ baako. 23Na bamma bi twa ntuntuma nnan no mu hyia twan, na wɔayeyɛ mmukyia, mmamma no ase, de atwa ho ahyia. 24Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Yeinom ne aduanenoa adan a efie no mu asomfo no nnoa ɔmanfoɔ no kum afɔdeɛ wɔ hɔ.

Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Abannwa ponkɛseɛ a ɛhwɛ apueeɛ no, wɔnto mu adwumayɛ nna nsia no nyinaa, na homeda no deɛ, wɔnhini, na bosome foforɔ da no nso, wɔnhini. Na ɔberempɔn no mfiri akyire, mfa ntwonoo kwan pono so mmɛgyina ɛpono kɛseɛ no aponnwa ho; na asɔfoɔ no mmɔ ne hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne n’asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ, na ɔnkoto nsɔre, ɛpono kɛseɛ no aponnwa ho, na ɔmfiri adi, na ɛpono kɛseɛ no deɛ, wɔnnto mu kɔsi anwummerɛ. Na asase no so nnipa no nso nkoto nsɔre ɛpono kɛseɛ no ano, home nna ne abosome foforɔ mu, AWURADE anim. Na ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a ɔberempɔn no mfa mmrɛ AWURADE no nie: Homeda, nnwanten nsia a wɔnni dɛm ne odwennini a ne ho nni dɛm; ne aduane afɔdeɛ: Odwennini no deɛ, efa ne nnwanten no ho aduane afɔdeɛ a ne nsa bɛso soɔ ne ngo susutoa a ɛka efa no ho. Na bosome foforɔ da no: Nantwiburuwa a ɔnni dɛm ne nnwanten nsia ne odwennini baako a wɔnni dɛm, ne nantwinini no ho efa ne odwennini no ho efa na ɔmfa nyɛ aduane afɔdeɛ ne nnwanten no deɛ, sɛdeɛ ne nsa bɛso soɔ, ne ngo susutoa a ɛka efa ho. Na sɛ ɔberempɔn no rebɛhyɛne mu a, ɔmfa ɛpono kɛseɛ no ntwonoo kwan so nkɔ mu, na ɔmfa hɔ ara mfiri adi.
Na sɛ asase no so nnipa no reba AWURADE anim, afahyɛ no mu a, deɛ ɔfa atifi fam ponkɛseɛ no kwan so ba mu bɛsɔreɛ no, ɔmfa anafoɔ fam ponkɛseɛ no kwan so mfiri adi, na deɛ ɔfa anafoɔ fam ponkɛseɛ ano ba mu no, ɔmfa atifi fam ponkɛseɛ no ano mfiri adi; ɔnnsan mmfa ɛpono kɛseɛ a ɔfaa mu baa mu no mu mmfiri adi, na ɔnkɔ n’anim tee mfiri adi. Na ɔberempɔn no, sɛ wɔreba mu a, ɔmfra wɔn mu mmra mu, na sɛ wɔrefiri adi a, ɔne wɔn mfiri adi.
Na nnapɔnna ne afahyɛ no mu aduane afɔdeɛ nyɛ nantwinini ne aduane efa, ne odwennini ne aduane efa, ne nnwanten ho deɛ ne nsa bɛso soɔ, ne aduane efa ho ngo susutoa. Na sɛ ɔberempɔn no rebɛbɔ ayamyi hyeɛ afɔdeɛ anaa ayamyɛ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ ama AWURADE a, ɛnneɛ wɔnhini no ɛpono kɛseɛ a ɛhwɛ apueeɛ no, na ɔmmɔ ne hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne n’asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ, sɛdeɛ ɔyɛ no homeda no, na ɔmfiri adi; na n’adifire akyiri no, wɔnto ɛpono kɛseɛ no mu.
Na odwanten a wadi afe a ɔnni dɛm na fa bɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ma AWURADE; anɔpa anɔpa na bɔ; na siesie ɛho aduane afɔdeɛ daa anɔpa, efa nkyɛmu nsia mu baako, ne ngo susutoa nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako, na wɔmfa mfɔre esiam no na ɛnyɛ aduane afɔdeɛ mma AWURADE; ɛnyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ daa; na monsiesie odwanten no, ne aduane afɔdeɛ ne ngo no daa anɔpa: Ɛyɛ daa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ.
Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Sɛ ɔberempɔn no de n’agyapadeɛ no bi kyɛ ne mma no bi a, ɛyɛ ne mma no deɛ, wɔn agyapadeɛ mu kyɛfa ne no. Na sɛ ɔde n’agyapadeɛ no bi kyɛ ne nkoa mu bi a, ɛnneɛ ɛnyɛ akoa no deɛ nkɔsi ahofadie afe no so, na ɛnsane nkɔyɛ ɔberempɔn no deɛ bio, ɛyɛ ɔno ara agyapadeɛ, ne mma na ɛnyɛ wɔn deɛ. Nanso ɔberempɔn no mmfa ɔmanfoɔ no agyapadeɛ bi, mmpam wɔn mfiri wɔn kyɛfa mu; ɔno ara ne kyɛfa no bi na ɔmfa mma ne mma na wɔnnie, deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na wɔampansam me man mu onipa biara amfiri n’agyapadeɛ soɔ. Ɛnna ɔde me faa ɔkwan a ɛda ɛpono kɛseɛ no nhyɛnmu no so kɔɔ adammoa kronkron a ɛyɛ asɔfoɔ dea, a ɛhwɛ atifi fam no ano, na hwɛ, afa bi wɔ hɔ, atɔeɛ fam, akyire nohoa. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Ɛha ne faako a asɔfoɔ no bɛnoa asodie ho afɔdeɛ ne bɔne ho afɔdeɛ no, na wɔatoto aduane afɔdeɛ no, na wɔamfa amfiri adi ankɔ abannwa a ɛwɔ ho no so ankɔte ɔman no ho.
Ɛnna ɔde me firii adi baa abannwa a ɛwɔ ho no soɔ, na ɔmaa mesene kɔɔ abannwa no ntweaso nnan no ho, na hwɛ, atuntuma bi wɔ abannwa no biara ntweaso. Abannwa no ntwea nnan no mu na ntuntuma a wɔabram ho wowɔ a ne ntwemu yɛ basafa aduonu na ne trɛ yɛ basafa dunum, ntweaso ntutuma nnan no nyinaa nsusuiɛ yɛ baako. Na bamma bi twa ntuntuma nnan no mu hyia twan, na wɔayeyɛ mmukyia, mmamma no ase, de atwa ho ahyia. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Yeinom ne aduanenoa adan a efie no mu asomfo no nnoa ɔmanfoɔ no kum afɔdeɛ wɔ hɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
